tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
AC Power Cord UK to C19 16A 4M – Reliable 16AWG Replacement for Server & UPS


Ensure stable and safe power delivery to your critical equipment with this high-quality AC Power Cord featuring a UK BS1363 plug to C19 connector. Designed specifically for servers, UPS systems, and other high-power IT devices, this 4-meter long cable supports up to 16 amps at 250 volts, making it ideal for demanding data center and network environments.

Constructed with durable 16AWG copper wire and a robust black PVC jacket, this replacement power cord guarantees excellent conductivity, heat resistance, and longevity. The C19 connector is compatible with a wide range of servers, UPS units, and power distribution units (PDUs) from leading brands, ensuring seamless integration and reliable operation.


Key Features:

  • Length: 4 meters (13 feet) for flexible equipment placement
  • Rated for 16A, 250V to support high power loads
  • 16AWG heavy-duty copper wire for optimal electrical performance
  • UK BS1363 plug (13A fused) for standard UK outlets
  • C19 connector designed for high-current IT equipment
  • Compatible with major server and UPS brands and models
  • Flame-retardant and durable PVC jacket for safety and durability
